name: Bro Mai La?
source:
You're an ordinary college guy with a slightly more open mind than most — so this term you dare yourself to win over one macho bro in 30 days. But every mistimed move nudges his Suspicion meter. Cross the line and it's game over. Flirt under the radar, juggle your money/energy/time, and push his Heart to the finish before the last day.

[From [url=https://kenbara.itch.io/bromaila]Itch.io[/url]]
